audit.why: TRICKY 7/10 fits: Taliyah owns early lane vs the weakest early laner, Vlad outscales hard — 46.83% WR over 709 games reflects the late flip.

audit.whatIsWrong: The two layers disagreed on five rows: full carried blanket 'Skill' 0-4 while content and packet say Taliyah 0-3 / Skill at 6; full said Vladimir at first item while its own why described Taliyah winning; content win[6] said Taliyah while full says Vladimir at 2+ items.
audit.why: Kit adjudication: Vlad is the scaler (Crimson Pact, Hemoplague amp, 16s max-rank pool) so 2+ items is his; first item is Taliyah's Lost Chapter tempo before his health-stacking arrives.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-3 and 5 aligned to Taliyah in full; row 6 flipped to Vladimir in content; every moved row's why rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: Taliyah's W-E called a 'root' in five content fields (Unraveled Earth stuns). Missing interactions: Sanguine Pool untargetability (28s rank 1 / 16s max, 2s duration) dodging her burst was stated only vaguely; anti-heal vs Transfusion/Hemoplague already present in report[8].
audit.why: Kit text: mines 'explode and stun them'; pool 'untargetable for 2 seconds'.
audit.corrected: root→stun everywhere; pool duration and cooldown numbers now concrete in report[5] and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Copy-paste bleed in dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d; unsourced 'TP doubles' magnitude in report[7].t.
audit.corrected: Rewritten to match titles; magnitude removed.

edits.after: Taliyah

edits.before: Q on fresh ground shreds level-1 trades — most mids don't expect five stones at minute two. Manage your Worked Ground like mana.
edits.after: Vladimir has no waveclear and a 9-second Transfusion at rank 1 — your Q from fresh ground dominates the level-1 shove and poke.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Taliyah

edits.before: W online: the shove-displacement already threatens kill angles against overstep-happy laners.
edits.after: W online: shove Vladimir when he steps up to Q a minion — without pool up he cannot answer.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Taliyah

edits.before: Full kit: W-into-E is the signature burst — shove him across the stones and watch half a health bar disappear.
edits.after: Full kit: W him across E stones for the stun — if Sanguine Pool (28s) is down, the combo is a kill threat.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Taliyah

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — Q-poke on every wave contact. Fresh-ground positioning is your real skill expression now.
edits.after: Lost Chapter timing — Q-poke every wave contact keeps a sustain-starved Vlad below his Q healing and off the wave.

edits.before: Weaver's Wall online — you are now the best roaming mid in the game. Every shove is a bot-lane gank announcement.
edits.after: Level 6 is the skill check: his Hemoplague-pool all-in arrives just as your Weaver's Wall roam pressure does.

edits.before: Vladimir
edits.after: Taliyah

edits.before: Luden's spike: the W-E-Q rotation deletes squishies. Force river fights where your stones pre-seed the geometry.
edits.after: Lost Chapter waveclear spikes before his health-stacking does — keep shoving, deny stacks, roam while he farms.

edits.before: Late Taliyah edits maps: wall their reinforcements, shove their frontline into your team, and Q whatever stands on stones.
edits.after: Two-plus items Vlad outscales: Hemoplague amps his team's damage and pool dodges your combo — group and flank, don't duel.

edits.before: Taliyah
edits.after: Vladimir

edits.before: You out-range him into items, zoning with E and Wall to bait his pool before your team commits.
edits.after: Scaled Vlad wins: Hemoplague amps damage and pool dodges your combo — bait pool before you commit.

edits.before: - Vladimir Sanguine Pool: matchup-defining — Untargetable dodge — bait it before you spend your kill window. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W Seismic Shove for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Sanguine Pool is 28s at rank 1, 16 at max — bait it before you spend your kill window; step up only in that downtime. - Transfusion falls from 9s to 4.6s, so long trades feed his sustain. - Budget W for emergencies, R for opportunities.

edits.before: Q from fresh ground on his last-hit, and if he steps to answer, W-shove him across the E-field — the full geometry trade is half a health bar.
edits.after: Crash then wall-surf: Vlad's clear is too slow to answer waves and too weak to follow roams — every crash he loses a plate or a teammate does.

edits.before: Trading while standing on your own Worked Ground — one-stone Qs lose every exchange your positioning already conceded.
edits.after: W is 14 seconds at rank 1 — thrown as poke, you have no stun setup and no answer when he commits with Hemoplague and Ignite.

edits.before: Track Vladimir’s Sanguine Pool: Untargetable dodge — bait it before you spend your kill window. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Sanguine Pool makes him untargetable for 2 seconds and dodges your full combo — bait it, then commit in its 28-16s downtime.

edits.before: Flash + Teleport or Ignite — TP doubles the roam thesis; Ignite converts the W-E burst into early deletions. Pick by how hard you intend to roam.
edits.after: Flash + Teleport or Ignite — TP extends the roam plan cross-map; Ignite converts the W-E burst into early deletions. Pick by how hard you intend to roam.

edits.before: Your level-3 W-E root kills him when Sanguine Pool is down.
edits.after: Your level-3 W-E stun kills him when Sanguine Pool is down.

edits.before: Vladimir is miserable early: high Transfusion cooldown, no mana bar to punish but no sustain when Q is down, and no waveclear. Shove with Threaded Volley and poke him below his Q sustain, then W-E on worked ground to root him before he can Sanguine Pool out.
edits.after: Vladimir is miserable early: high Transfusion cooldown, no mana bar to punish but no sustain when Q is down, and no waveclear. Shove with Threaded Volley and poke him below his Q sustain, then W-E on worked ground to stun him before he can Sanguine Pool out.

edits.before: Vladimir has one of the weakest laning phases into you: Transfusion has a long early cooldown, he has no waveclear, and when his Q is down he has no sustain at all. Push with Threaded Volley, poke him whenever he steps up, and force him below his sustain. At level 3, W Seismic Shove into worked-ground E Unraveled Earth roots him, and if his Sanguine Pool is on cooldown it's a kill.
edits.after: Vladimir has one of the weakest laning phases into you: Transfusion has a long early cooldown, he has no waveclear, and when his Q is down he has no sustain at all. Push with Threaded Volley, poke him whenever he steps up, and force him below his sustain.
